lines.text: Stop. Turn around. You cannot see the stall from here, can you.
My grandmother walked this far every morning. I have been telling people the posts were the reason I stayed.

text.text: You don't have to say it.

lines.text: I was frightened. That is all it ever was. Thank you for making it boring.
No. But I would like to have said it out loud once, in a field, with a witness.
Right. Back before the lanterns go. I have a stall to open in the morning.
